Genuine transparent background; generous margins; no ground patch, shadow puddle, text, roof, border or scenery. Same front three-quarter camera about20degrees down; light upper-left, darker right/lower shade. Fine broken sepia-charcoal ink, main/detail2:1; quiet broad earth wash, no dense texture or3D bevel. Stone3 selective crack/facet groups per dominant rock; wood3 broken longitudinal grain lines per principal beam; clay3 short crack groups; hatching one group of3 parallel / marks. Physical footprint unchanged. Only the square low stone tower foundation with clear south doorway gap, top-down square footprint matching tower base. Two courses high; empty interior visible; no platform, ladder, doorway leaf or upper story. Intended game opaque height30px, footprint[2, 2]; preserve material and component identity at1x. CRITICAL silhouette: low broad square base, complete SAME tower base width around75px; total visible sprite width2.5times opaque height30px. One or two stone courses ONLY; doorway is a gap WITHOUT a lintel.
